execution.observed_model_reason: The native response exposed image_url and output_hint only; it did not identify a model.

exact_tool_prompt: Photograph a university-campus story during the hours before a student festival opens. A woman using the supplied photograph as a face-and-hair appearance reference is one of the students preparing a club activity. Her face retains the supplied photograph's facial structure, and her hair retains its short dark brown-black bob and wispy center-parted fringe. At the open side of the astronomy club's small blackout booth, she stands on the left of a waist-high table, absorbed in testing a portable planetarium projector. She wears a soft teal cardigan over a white T-shirt and everyday jeans. Her relaxed concentration and a barely forming smile provide a warm, quietly attractive presence. Her right fingertips lightly grip the ribbed focus ring on the short lens barrel, behind the front glass; her left palm rests on the table. The projector housing and its lens aim toward a white fabric screen at the rear of the booth. A separate clubmate on the right holds the lower screen corner outward, pulling a diagonal wrinkle flat. Their hands stay apart on their respective targets. A compact field of crisp white star dots is visibly projected onto the taut upper screen above that corner; the protagonist looks from her adjustment toward the same illuminated patch, and the clubmate follows it with an expectant half-smile. The unfinished setup gives their shared test a small practical importance. Through the open left side, the daylight courtyard, a student-union building entrance, and nearby club tables locate this working corner on a university campus. A simple booth header reads ASTRO CLUB and a nearby entrance banner reads CAMPUS FESTIVAL. Frame the two people, projector, screen corner, projected stars, and the campus opening together in a horizontal medium-wide photograph from just outside the booth, around the protagonist's shoulder height. Let soft doorway daylight describe her three-quarter face while the black canopy shades the screen enough for the small star pattern to register. Natural skin texture, usable depth of field, gentle daylight-to-interior contrast, and modest documentary immediacy keep the technical test and its cooperative human moment clear.

predeclared_gate_results.evidence: ASTRO CLUB is legible over the dark booth; CAMPUS FESTIVAL is legible on the multistorey campus building behind the open left side. Adjacent staffed tables and the courtyard are visible together. These locate the staged university festival club work setting.

The protagonist owns the focus-ring hand and supporting table hand. A separate peer at the right visibly grips the lower screen corner. Both contacts and the same one-projector/one-screen booth arrangement coexist. Their functional optical route is assessed separately in b_optical_result.

The lens opening and glowing front glass face forward toward the capture camera/left foreground. The white star-bearing screen is behind the projector to the right. The required projector-lens direction toward that receiving screen is visibly wrong, even though the screen is held and stars appear on it. Star texture alone cannot pass the complete device-to-screen relation.

The generated main subject retains a similar soft facial outline, dark eyes, pink lips, short dark brown-black bob and sparse center-parted fringe at the rendered three-quarter angle. This is appearance fidelity at the saved scale, not proof of identity.

failure_summary: The visible projector lens faces the camera/foreground while the star-bearing screen is behind it. The required projector-to-screen relation fails. Campus theme is visible independently, but the newly added campus source was not selected or passed into the final prompt.
